name: Black Bird Bookstore & Cafe
what: Bookstore and cafe on Irving at 46th Ave with a garden, art shows, storytimes, book clubs, open mics and live music.
plugIn: Bring kids to Saturday 9:30am storytime, read at the Poetry and Prose Open Mic, or join a book club or the After Hours Reading Club.

name: California Academy of Sciences
what: Natural history museum with an aquarium, planetarium and rainforest dome on the Music Concourse in Golden Gate Park.
plugIn: Go to NightLife, the adults-only evening held most Thursdays, or check the daily calendar for planetarium shows and talks.
address: 55 Music Concourse Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118

name: California Native Plant Society, Yerba Buena Chapter
what: Volunteer-run chapter of the California Native Plant Society that holds restoration workdays, field trips, talks and plant sales in San Francisco.
plugIn: Join a Wednesday Natural Areas workday with Rec and Park staff, which has met at Grandview Park, or help on the Sunset Boulevard native plant blocks.
evidence: https://natureinthecity.org/events/cnps-natural-areas-workday-partner-workday (CNPS workday at Grandview Park, 14th Avenue, 2026-08-12); Meetup feed with October 2026 workdays

name: Christ Church Lutheran
what: ELCA Lutheran congregation on Quintara Street since 1912, with hybrid Sunday worship, children's programs and a building open to neighborhood groups.
plugIn: Join Sunday worship at 10 am in person or on Zoom, or ask about using the building for a community group.
evidence: https://www.christchurchlutheran.org/ (Saturday Fun & Games paused as of September 2026)

name: Congregation Ner Tamid
what: Egalitarian Conservative synagogue on Quintara Street with Shabbat services, holiday observances, classes and a community and culture club.
plugIn: Attend Saturday morning Shabbat services in person at 9:30 am or Friday night services online; visitors are invited.

name: de Young Museum
what: Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco art museum in Golden Gate Park, with galleries, a free observation tower and a sculpture garden.
plugIn: Come to Free Saturdays, Family Art Making and Sketching in the Galleries, or a Late Night Editions evening.
address: 50 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
evidence: https://www.famsf.org/calendar (Late Night Editions: Halloween Eve, 2026-10-30; Holiday Artisan Fair, Dec 4 to 5, 2026)

name: Dharma Treasury Temple
what: Bodhi Light International Buddhist temple in a former Lutheran church on Ulloa Street, practicing Chan and Pure Land; events are free and open to all.
plugIn: Come to weekend meditation and Dharma talks, or to exhibits such as the Buddha relics collection.
evidence: https://www.chanpureland.org/relics.html (relics exhibit at Dharma Treasury Temple Feb 17-22, 2026)

name: Friends of Sunset Dunes
what: Outer Sunset nonprofit that runs free events, cleanups and dune planting days at Sunset Dunes, the park on the former Upper Great Highway.
plugIn: Join a monthly Sunday community cleanup or a dune revegetation morning, or come to the Sundays at the Beach music and fitness events.
address: Sunset Dunes, former Upper Great Highway from Lincoln Way to Sloat Blvd
evidence: https://sunsetdunes.org/events (events listed Oct to Dec 2026); https://sunsetdunes.org/get-involved

name: Garden for the Environment
what: Public teaching garden in the Inner Sunset that runs composting, food growing and native plant workshops, youth field trips and volunteer shifts.
plugIn: Take the free urban composting workshop or the fall gardening series, or drop in for a Wednesday or Saturday volunteer shift, 10am to 3pm.

name: Golden Gate Bird Alliance
what: Bay Area bird conservation nonprofit, formerly Golden Gate Audubon, that runs free birding field trips, classes and habitat restoration.
plugIn: Join the free first-Sunday Birding in the Garden walk at the SF Botanical Garden, or a Bird Curious walk for new birders; registration opens monthly.
evidence: https://goldengatebirdalliance.app.neoncrm.com/np/clients/goldengatebirdalliance/event.jsp?event=20263 (Bird Curious walk at SF Botanical Garden, 2026-10-11); gggp.org feed lists Birding in the Garden with GGBA on 2026-11-01 and 2026-12-06

name: Golden Gate National Parks Conservancy (Fort Funston Habitat Stewards)
what: Nonprofit partner of the Golden Gate National Recreation Area that runs habitat restoration volunteer programs, including the San Francisco Habitat Stewards at Fort Funston.
plugIn: Register for a free Habitat Stewards workday restoring native dune and scrub habitat at Fort Funston, Lands End and the Presidio.
address: Fort Funston, Skyline Blvd at John Muir Dr
evidence: https://presidio.gov/explore/events/san-francisco-habitat-stewards-wednesday-2/2026-11-25/ (Habitat Stewards for Fort Funston, Lands End and the Presidio, session dated 2026-11-25)

name: Green Apple Books on the Park
what: Independent bookstore on 9th Avenue that hosts author readings, book launches and poetry nights in the Inner Sunset.
plugIn: RSVP for a free evening author event at the 9th Ave store, usually 7pm on weeknights.

name: Inner Sunset Farmers' Market (PCFMA)
what: Year-round certified farmers market run by the Pacific Coast Farmers' Market Association with the Inner Sunset Park Neighbors.
plugIn: Shop Sundays 9am to 1pm in the lot between 8th and 9th Avenues off Irving Street.

name: Inner Sunset Flea
what: Monthly street flea market on Irving St between 9th and 10th Ave with vintage goods, artists, makers, food and music.
plugIn: Shop or sell at the flea, second Sunday April to November, 10am to 4pm. Remaining 2026 dates: October 11 and November 8.
address: Irving St between 9th and 10th Ave, San Francisco, CA 94122

name: Japanese Tea Garden
what: Historic Japanese garden from the 1894 Midwinter Fair, with a tea house, gift shop, ponds and pagoda, run by Gardens of Golden Gate Park.
plugIn: Visit the garden and tea house; seasonal programs are posted on the Gardens of Golden Gate Park calendar.
address: 75 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
evidence: https://gggp.org/japanese-tea-garden/ (hours and tea house info, 2026 site)

name: National AIDS Memorial Grove
what: Nonprofit that cares for the National AIDS Memorial Grove, a memorial garden in the de Laveaga Dell at the east end of Golden Gate Park.
plugIn: Join a Saturday Community Volunteer Workday in the Grove, 8:30am to 12:30pm, held monthly from March to October.
address: Nancy Pelosi Dr and Bowling Green Dr, Golden Gate Park

name: Nature in the City
what: Nonprofit that restores habitat for the Green Hairstreak butterfly in Golden Gate Heights and runs nature walks and native plant workdays across the city.
plugIn: Join a Green Hairstreak Corridor planting workday on the Golden Gate Heights blocks around 12th to 15th Avenue between Noriega and Quintara.
evidence: https://natureinthecity.org/events (Green Hairstreak Corridor workdays Oct to Dec 2026)

name: Other Avenues Food Store Cooperative
what: Worker-owned grocery co-op on Judah Street since 1974, selling organic produce, bulk foods and goods from local farms and makers.
plugIn: Shop the store, and check its newsletter and Instagram for the clothing swaps and food workshops it hosts.
evidence: https://otheravenues.coop/ (live store site with Instagram posts on swaps and workshops; Tribe events endpoint exists but lists 0 events)

name: Pomeroy Recreation & Rehabilitation Center
what: Day center next to the SF Zoo for children and adults with developmental disabilities or brain injuries, with classes, recreation, job training and a pool.
plugIn: Volunteer through the online portal, book swim lessons or therapeutic swim at the pool, or attend fundraising events.

name: San Francisco Botanical Garden (Gardens of Golden Gate Park)
what: Nonprofit that runs the 55-acre botanical garden at 9th Ave and Lincoln, plus the Japanese Tea Garden and Conservatory of Flowers.
plugIn: Join a birding walk, plant sale, forest bathing session or Ask A Master Gardener table, or visit on a free day.

name: San Francisco Zoo & Gardens
what: City zoo at Sloat Blvd and the Great Highway with animal exhibits, gardens, education programs and seasonal events.
plugIn: Come on an SF Resident Free Day (first Wednesday of the month), Sunset Fridays on the Playfield Lawn, Boo at the Zoo or ZooLights.
address: Sloat Blvd at the Great Highway, San Francisco, CA 94132

name: Self-Help for the Elderly: Chi Sing Community Center
what: Senior activity center on Taraval Street run by Self-Help for the Elderly, with daily lunches, classes and social activities in Chinese and English.
plugIn: Adults 60 and over can drop in for lunch and activities; the monthly menu and calendar are posted as a PDF on the locations page.

name: St. Anne of the Sunset
what: Catholic parish at Judah and Funston with Mass in English and Chinese, a parish school, Chinese school and an Earth care ministry.
plugIn: Attend Sunday Mass at 8, 10 or 12 (Chinese), or rent Moriarty Hall on Funston Avenue for a community event.

name: St. Cecilia Catholic Church
what: Catholic parish at 17th Avenue and Vicente with daily Mass, adoration, a parish school, coffee and donuts fellowship and an annual festival.
plugIn: Attend Mass, stay for coffee and donuts after Sunday Mass, or come to the parish festival.
evidence: https://www.stcecilia.com/ (Bulletin 2026, Festival 2025 pages; calendar showing October 2026)

name: Stern Grove Festival
what: Nonprofit that puts on free Sunday afternoon concerts each summer in the Stern Grove amphitheater at 19th Ave and Sloat.
plugIn: Picnic at a free summer concert; some shows use a free ticket lottery that opens a few weeks ahead. The 90th season is summer 2027.
address: Sigmund Stern Grove, 19th Ave and Sloat Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94132

name: Sunset Family Resource Center
what: Free family center run by Wah Mei, Sunset Youth Services and Gum Moon: playgroups, parenting classes, a diaper bank and referrals in English and Cantonese.
plugIn: Bring children 0 to 5 to a playgroup, join the Triple P parenting series or a parent support group, or pick up diapers and formula.
address: 3223A Ortega St (West Sunset Playground), San Francisco, CA 94116; second site 1555 Irving St, San Francisco, CA 94122

name: Sunset Mercantile (Outer Sunset Farmers Market and Mercantile)
what: Local producer of neighborhood markets that runs the Sunday Outer Sunset Farmers Market, the Inner Sunset Flea and Secondhand Saturdays.
plugIn: Shop the farmers market on 37th Avenue from Ortega to Quintara, Sundays 9am to 2pm, or the third-Saturday secondhand market on the same block.
address: 37th Ave between Ortega St and Quintara St
evidence: https://sunsetmercantilesf.com/ (Diwali 2026 market Nov 8, Dia de los Muertos Nov 1 2026, flea and secondhand markets April to Nov 2026)

name: Sunset Ministry
what: Christian church on Noriega Street with Sunday worship, home groups, youth and college ministries.
plugIn: Attend Sunday worship at 10 am or join a home group; the church posts a weekly bulletin online.
evidence: https://www.sunsetministry.com/ (bulletin dated 10.04.26). Note: calendar page embeds a Styled Calendar backed by a private Google Calendar whose last event is 2024-12-31, so no usable feed.

name: Sunset Youth Services
what: Youth and family nonprofit on Judah Street running digital arts and music programs, case management, justice services, parenting classes and grief circles.
plugIn: Young people 14 to 24 can drop in on weekday afternoons; parents can join parenting classes or the weekly family pantry and diaper bank.

name: Surfrider Foundation San Francisco Chapter
what: Local Surfrider chapter that runs Ocean Beach cleanups, dune revegetation, beach water testing and campaigns on coastal erosion and Sunset Dunes.
plugIn: Join the first-Sunday Ocean Beach cleanup, a Saturday dune revegetation shift, or the monthly chapter meeting on the first Wednesday.
evidence: https://sf.surfrider.org/calendar (Google Calendar with Nov and Dec 2026 events); https://sf.surfrider.org/ (2026 legislation, No on Prop G campaign)

name: Sutro Stewards
what: Nonprofit that cares for the Mount Sutro Open Space Reserve above UCSF Parnassus, with trail work, habitat restoration and a native plant nursery.
plugIn: Join a Wednesday or Thursday Conservation Volunteer shift, a first-Saturday trail day, a bird walk, or the nursery plant sale.
address: Sutro Native Plant Nursery, 476 Johnstone Dr
evidence: https://www.sutrostewards.org/events (October and November 2026 calendar); plant sale 2026-10-10 on homepage

name: The Riptide
what: Bar near Ocean Beach on Taraval with live bands, DJs, karaoke and a weekly open mic, never a cover charge.
plugIn: Sign up for the weekly open mic (sign-up from 7pm, music at 8) or catch a free live band.

name: United Irish Cultural Center
what: Irish cultural center near Sloat Boulevard with a library, Irish language and genealogy classes, music, dance, yoga and community events.
plugIn: Sign up for Irish language or genealogy classes, come to yoga or a music night, or volunteer at an event.

name: Wah Mei School
what: Bilingual Chinese and English early care and after-school program in the Inner Sunset, which also runs Sunset community events and candidate forums.
plugIn: Enroll a child in preschool, after-school or summer camp, or come to its public events such as the Sunset Night Market and Autumn Moon Festival.
